guides.title: What is DAX?
guides.subtitle: Decentralized Agreement Infrastructure (Agreements + Escrow + Evidence + Dispute Resolution)
guides.content:
DAX is decentralized agreement infrastructure.

In short:
DAX lets two parties create enforceable digital agreements backed by on-chain assets, with structured obligations, evidence, disputes, and settlement — without DAX custodying their funds.

Even shorter:
DAX = Agreements + Escrow + Evidence + Dispute Resolution.

It supports trades, services, milestones, deliveries, recurring work, and other bilateral commitments across multiple blockchain networks.

• Vault: Protects what you own (tokens, accounts, keys).
• Agreements: Protects what you commit to (contracts, escrow tranches).
• Evidence: Proves what happened (encrypted files, Merkle proofs).
• Court: Resolves what goes wrong (jurors, staking, verdicts).

guides.title: How On-Chain Escrow Works
guides.subtitle: Step-by-step lifecycle of a DAX agreement
guides.content:
Escrow ensures neither party can run away with money or deliverables.

1. Creation: Party A creates an agreement specifying terms, counterparty, and payment amount (e.g. 5,000 USDT).

2. Funding: Party A locks the funds into the DAX Escrow contract on Arbitrum One.

3. Delivery & Evidence: Party B performs work or sends deliverables, attaching encrypted proof files.

4. Settlement: Once Party A verifies delivery, they sign an off-chain EIP-712 release. Escrow automatically pays Party B instantly with zero platform fees.

5. Dispute Option: If expectations are not met, either party can escalate to DAX Court before funds are released.

guides.title: Evidence Vault & Cryptographic Proofs
guides.subtitle: How private files become immutable proof without leaking data
guides.content:
Why don't we store whole PDF or ZIP files directly on the blockchain?

Because storing megabytes on-chain is expensive and exposes your private files to the public!

DAX solves this with Merkle commitments:

• Your files (receipts, screenshots, zips) are encrypted locally using AES-256-GCM.
• A SHA-256 Merkle root hash is generated from all evidence.
• Only this 32-byte cryptographic root is committed on-chain.

This guarantees that neither party can alter, replace, or backdate evidence after the fact. In a dispute, authorized jurors verify that provided files match the on-chain Merkle root.

guides.title: DAX Court: Juror Arbitration
guides.subtitle: Decentralized justice without expensive lawyers or courts
guides.content:
When a dispute occurs, DAX Court steps in to arbitrate fairly.

• Independent Jurors: Selected randomly based on staked DAX tokens (minimum 100 DAX) to ensure impartial verdicts.
• Evidence Review: Jurors receive authorized decryptable evidence files and agreement terms.
• Majority Consensus: Jurors vote independently. Coherent jurors who vote with the consensus receive rewards from dispute fees.
• Automated Execution: Once the verdict is recorded, smart contracts immediately disburse or refund the escrow according to the court ruling.

guides.title: Vault Security & Seed Backup Guide
guides.subtitle: Safeguard your secret 12-word recovery phrase
guides.content:
DAX is 100% self-custodial. We do not hold your keys or have a database of passwords.

• Write It Down: Keep your 12 recovery words written physically on paper in a secure location.
• Never Share: No DAX team member will ever ask for your seed words or private key.
• Hardware Security: On your phone, keys are encrypted using AES-256 inside the hardware Keystore.
• Biometric Lock: Enable fingerprint/PIN locks for instant local protection.

guides.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
guides.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about DAX
guides.content:
Q: What if the counterparty stops responding?
A: Agreements have expiration timestamps. If the other party does not deliver before expiry, you can trigger a refund or escalate to DAX Court.

Q: Does DAX charge custody or trading fees?
A: No. DAX is non-custodial and operates with zero protocol platform fees on standard escrow settlements.

Q: Can I restore my vault on another phone?
A: Yes! Enter your 12 secret recovery words into 'Restore Vault' to access your funds and accounts anywhere.
